# CameraPose

Where a [`BenchmarkConfig`](BenchmarkConfig.md) starts the camera.

## Parameters

- `position`: An array of 3 floats. World-space position. Defaults to `[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]`.
- `yaw_deg`: A float. Heading in degrees. `0` looks toward -Z. Defaults to `0.0`.
- `pitch_deg`: A float. Elevation in degrees. Positive looks up. Defaults to `0.0`.
